title: LunarLab: auditable reward-design experiments in reinforcement learning
description:
LunarLab, a research toolkit for auditable reward-design experiments in reinforcement learning: named reward decomposition, validation-based checkpoint selection, protected final-test artifacts, behavioral diagnostics and verified replay, with command-line, Python and local web interfaces.

This record is created from a GitHub release and holds the repository at that release: the source code, tests, documentation, study protocols and records, three example policy packages and six learned-reward packages. Trained policies that are not in the repository are not in this record.

Limitations: bit-identical results across operating systems are not a supported guarantee; on Linux, one of the 38 study policies does not reproduce its recorded mean return. No independent person has yet used LunarLab.
